units.source_text: 就在这个时候，有人悄悄来到我身边。

en.t: Just then, someone quietly came to my side.

units.source_text: 我想转头看看，但是周围很昏暗。

en.t: I tried to turn my head and look, but everything around me was dim.

units.source_text: 是谁——不知道是谁，用看不见的手拔走了我胸口的小刀。

en.t: Who was it? I do not know who it was, but some unseen hand pulled the dagger from my chest.
The taste of blood welled up in my mouth again.

units.source_text: 就这样，我永远沦陷在冥世的黑暗深渊中了。……

en.t: And so I sank forever into the dark abyss of the world of the dead.
